study: S12 (reading of X1/X2/X4) → S13 (route-A representation arms)
parent_commit: 413a11e (S11 code; the S12 analysis, its evidence and this file were uncommitted when it was frozen). The P0 items below must land first; their commit is recorded in the S13 page.

S09.role: H12a rejected and H14b rejected route the project to A (representation/data). H15 (X3) is re-used unchanged.

S10.role: H16 supported (capacity ample). X5/X6 are not run as standalone arms (S12 D25); X5's change is part of arm Y3 here.

motivating_evidence: S12 findings F59–F71 (evidence/S12_frozen_arms_reading/). Held-out rows of the S11 cells were read once by their own final evaluation and, in S12, aggregated diagnostically (late fusion with equal or calib-chosen weights; linear controls). Nothing in this file was tuned on them beyond what S12 reports openly: Y1 is motivated by the diagnostic late fusion (F65), Y2 by the session channel located in within-kernel statistics (F67, F69), Y3 by structural defects (F48, F49) and the linear equivalence of the spectral pathway (F66).

regime.name: R1 (= X1, S12 D24)
regime.overrides: single.mixup_epochs=30 single.arcface_m=0.0 single.margin_warmup_start=31 single.margin_warmup_end=31 grad_clip=50.0 single.epochs=200 single.patience=40
regime.unchanged: aux_weight_schedule=legacy, clip_partition=legacy, label smoothing 0.10→0.04, dropout 0.15, aug medium, EMA 0.999, AdamW 5e-4 cosine, k32 u430 reflectance (dataset_u430k32)

reference.margins: non-inferiority and gain margins are 2·max(observed sd, floor): F1 2·max(0.0099, 0.009) = 0.020; cross recall 2·max(0.0098, 0.009) = 0.020; attraction 2·max(0.0204, 0.009) = 0.040; same-session recall 2·max(0.0139, 0.009) = 0.028 → 0.020 used where it guards a gain elsewhere (stricter); stratified F1 2·max(0.0058, 0.009) = 0.018

metric: macro-F1 on val ∪ test, TTA, mean over runs (no-TTA reported beside); same/cross-session macro-recall and cross-session attraction from reporting/session.py; checkpoint chosen on calib only; every held-out kernel scored once (S11 de-dup). Reported but not decisive: the training-rows class-disjoint session κ (S12 session_probe.probe) of the embedding and of each pathway output.
p0_before_any_arm: Checkpoint race (S12 F71a): barrier after the stage and atomic (tmp + os.replace) save of best_stage1.pth before any rank reloads it; regression test with best epoch == last epoch under 2 gloo ranks
Provenance (S12 F71b): .gitignore `dataset_*` (no trailing slash) so the Kaggle dataset symlink does not mark every run dirty; a run whose `git status --porcelain` lists anything else stays dirty
Re-score X2/spatial_only__f1_s0 through the designed path (rerun the cell: the finished stage is detected and only the final evaluation runs); it decides nothing (S12 §5.2)
Late-fusion scorer (reads two cells' saved logits; weight chosen on calib; writes the same run.json/session fields as a model)
Session κ probe in the final report (training rows, embedding + pathway outputs)

Y1_decoupled_pathways.change: No model change. Train the two pathways as separate networks under R1 (model.pathways=[spectral] and model.pathways=[spatial], X2's switch: a disabled pathway is skipped and frozen; [spectral] has no aux term, [spatial] has no morphometrics). For each (fold, seed) fuse the two networks' log-softmax: z = w·log p_spectral + (1−w)·log p_spatial, w ∈ {0, 0.05, …, 1} chosen by macro-F1 on calib (TTA logits; ties → closest to 0.5), applied unchanged to held-out TTA logits. Equal weight (w = 0.5) reported beside.
Y1_decoupled_pathways.literature: Du et al., ICML 2023 (uni-modal ensemble when paired features are scarce); Wang, Tran & Feiszli, CVPR 2020 (modalities over-fit at different rates; the best uni-modal model often beats the joint one)
Y1_decoupled_pathways.runs: grouped folds 0,1 × seeds 0,1,2 × {spectral, spatial} = 12 runs → 6 fused cells

Y2_spatial_style_randomisation.change: Masked MixStyle (random-pair variant, Zhou et al. ICLR 2021) in the spatial stem, training only: after the GN→GELU→×α of 3-D stem blocks 1 and 2, with probability p = 0.5 per batch, each kernel's per-(channel, spectral-slice) mean and sd over its FOREGROUND pixels are mixed with another kernel's from the same batch, λ ~ Beta(0.1, 0.1); background stays zero. New key model.spatial_mixstyle (default off = today's model bit-for-bit). Full network, R1.
Y2_spatial_style_randomisation.literature: Zhou et al., ICLR 2021 (MixStyle); Li et al., ICLR 2022 (DSU) — instance feature statistics carry acquisition 'style'

Y3_lean_architecture.change: Remove what S10/S12 found inert or dead, nothing else: spectral descriptor = [SNV(r) 32 | morphometrics 8] (drop the index bank, continuum depths, D1, D2); spatial tail strides [2,2,2,1] (S10 X5: no structurally zero-gradient parameter); no CBAM after a block whose output is ≤ 2 × 2. New keys model.spectral_descriptor ∈ {full, snv_morph}, model.spatial_tail_strides, model.cbam_min_hw; defaults reproduce today's model bit-for-bit. Full network, R1.
Y3_lean_architecture.runs: grouped folds 0,1 × seeds 0,1,2 + stratified seeds 0,1,2 = 9 runs

Y4_within_acquisition_tier.change: S09's X3 unchanged in design: data=ablation/u430k32_stratified data.split_eval_frac=0.2, under R1 (the S09 text says 'the regime chosen by H12'; H12a was rejected, and S12 D24 makes R1 the reference regime).
Y4_within_acquisition_tier.role: the D16 tier-1 number; decides only H15 (frozen in S09, restated here unchanged)

hypotheses.H19a: Y1 fused grouped macro-F1 (TTA, mean of 6 fused cells) ≥ 0.530786 − 0.020 = 0.5108 (non-inferior to the jointly trained network)
hypotheses.H19b: Y1 fused cross-session recall ≥ 0.146637 + 0.020 = 0.1666 AND cross-session attraction ≤ 0.463958 − 0.040 = 0.4240
hypotheses.H20: Y2 cross-session recall ≥ 0.1666 AND same-session recall ≥ 0.648493 − 0.020 = 0.6285 (a move off the same/cross frontier, not along it)

decision_rule.H19a and H19b: decoupled pathways + calib-weighted late fusion become the reference form (SeedNet-D); joint fusion is retired
decision_rule.H19a, not H19b: no adoption; the joint network stays; record that decoupling does not buy session robustness under R1
decision_rule.not H19a: joint training carries paired information late fusion lacks; keep it
decision_rule.H20: supported → adopt masked MixStyle in the stem; rejected with cross ≥ +0.020 but same < −0.020 → a frontier move only, not adopted, reported as a trade-off point; rejected otherwise → instance statistics are not separable into session and variety here
decision_rule.H21a and H21b: adopt the lean architecture as the base of every later arm (SeedNet v5); the paper drops the index-bank/continuum/derivative claims
decision_rule.H21a xor H21b: dissect: descriptor and tail as two arms before adopting either
decision_rule.neither H21: keep today's architecture and record which removal is load-bearing as a finding
decision_rule.combination: arms adopted here are combined only in a later, separately frozen round; no combination is selected on held-out

guards: A run whose run.json → run.code.dirty is true for any reason other than the documented symlink, or whose commit is not the S13 commit, is not an S13 result
Any arm epoch with grad_norm/clip_fraction > 0.01 outside epoch 1 and fp16-overflow epochs is reported (S12 F71c)
Runs stopping before epoch 160 are reported (as D21 guard 4)
Y1's weight is chosen on calib only; the equal-weight number is reported beside it and decides nothing
not_in_this_round: CPU-first and later items: FW-27 a pixel-set (multiple-instance) spectral encoder trained on CPU with a calib gate; FW-28 TabPFN-3 on kernel summaries; FW-29 a transfer-standard (EPO-style, leave-varieties-out) protocol tier; FW-30 hyperspectral foundation-model encoders; FW-18 RGB morphology (needs the raw archive). Each needs its own frozen file before it touches held-out.
heldout_use: Each arm is scored once on val ∪ test. No arm, epoch, threshold, fusion weight or hyperparameter is chosen by its held-out score. A second round, if any, is a new frozen file naming what motivated it.
